description: This file defines the CommunicationApiController class, which handles API endpoints related to communication functionalities such as uploading images, checking communication status, and mail status within the Goteo project.

classes.name: CommunicationApiController
classes.description: Controller class managing API actions for communication-related operations such as image upload and status checks.

methods.name: validateCommunication
methods.description: Verifies user permissions to access communication features; throws exception if access is denied.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests for uploading images during communication editing.

methods.name: successAction
methods.description: Returns the status of a specific communication by its ID.

methods.name: mailStatusAction
methods.description: Retrieves and returns email sending and opening statistics for a specific mail.
